FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 23 : Big AI stocks were mixed on Friday, a day after the biggest decline in the Nasdaq Composite Index in four months, giving investors a welcome respite as they look forward to more information on Anthropic's forthcoming IPO and a further wave of earnings over the next week. Meta Platforms, the center of Thursday's storm, was fractionally lower following Thursday's 7 per cent decline. The operator of social media networks and major AI investor said in its earnings report this week that it would create a new class of shares in part to raise money for further capital spending, which was taken as evidence that the next leg of the AI buildout will be costly for shareholders. Other major AI players were mixed on Friday, with SpaceX, Oracle and Dell Technologies up 1 per cent to 2 per cent and Nvidia, Alphabet and Amazon down less than 1 per cent. Big semiconductor stocks were mostly higher after their largest decline since the summer on Thursday. Credit default swaps tracking the perceived risk of default at the biggest AI players were mostly modestly lower, with Meta's five-year CDS spread trading 0.3 per cent narrower at 123, according to LSEG data. The swaps enable investors to bet on a default using contracts typically with terms of five or 10 years, though contracts frequently change hands for the purposes of hedging positions and betting on near-term market moves.

Thursday's deluge and the day-after calm is the latest sign of indirection in a market that has hovered near record highs without breaking out, said Rick Meckler, partner at Cherry Lane Investments, a family investment office in New Vernon, New Jersey. "To some extent, we're seeing the market tread water over a longer period of time because every sell-off has been met by buyers and every point upward has been met by sellers," Meckler said. The Nasdaq was barely changed on Friday afternoon. Credit-default swap premiums, reflecting the annual cost borne by the swap purchaser in thousands of dollars, have risen over the past year with concern about the risks being taken on by large AI spenders. The premiums rose on Thursday after Meta's decision to sell more stock, as much of the buildout to date has been financed through debt issuance. The concerns around AI spending and investment returns have added to the market's volatility since Treasury yields rose sharply in August, which changed the economics of investing and bond issuance, given the increasing attractiveness of a higher risk-free rate. It's been "a very volatile week," said Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B Riley Wealth in Boston. "There's no doubt at some point in time that the higher inflation moves, especially if driven by unsustainably higher energy prices ... would have to show up in corporate earnings. It hasn't yet, but that's the concern. And market participants are trying to position for that." Shares of neoclouds, smaller companies tied to AI data centers and other infrastructure projects like CoreWeave, have dropped due to anxiety over their future. Their performance of late has also raised talk on Wall Street that capital is growing scarce - which stands to raise costs further and potentially raise funding issues down the road. Even so, many investors remain positive on the sector, where giant AI lab Anthropic is expected to publish its IPO prospectus in coming days and Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft are expected to report earnings next week. "In general, AI news in terms of revenues continues to be very strong, it's just at what cost and how long that growth is sustainable," Meckler said. "We really haven't gotten to the point of the market sort of focusing on winners and losers. It's been one big sector trade every day."

Source: Reuters

item.title: Leclerc marca el mejor tiempo para Ferrari en las pruebas del GP de EEUU
item.description: Charles Leclerc lideró el viernes con Ferrari los entrenamientos del Gran Premio de Estados Unidos, con Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes, muy cerca en segunda posición de cara a una carrera que podría convertirlo en el campeón del mundo más joven de la Fórmula 1.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Charles Leclerc lideró el viernes con Ferrari los entrenamientos del Gran Premio de Estados Unidos, con Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes, muy cerca en segunda posición de cara a una carrera que podría convertirlo en el campeón del mundo más joven de la Fórmula 1. Leclerc marcó el mejor tiempo, con un minuto y 35,291 segundos, en la segunda sesión en el Circuito de las Américas de Austin tras haber registrado la vuelta más rápida en la primera tanda con marca de 1:36,052 a bordo de su monoplaza mejorado en una pista llena de baches. Antonelli, de 20 años y que debe ganar el domingo para tener una primera oportunidad de hacerse con el título, quedó quinto en la primera sesión, en la que Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, fue el más cercano a Leclerc, ganador de la carrera en 2024. El italiano, que se quejó de que su asiento se movía, mejoró hasta el segundo puesto y terminó el día a 0,042 del mejor tiempo. Verstappen, ganador en Austin el año pasado, busca su tercera victoria consecutiva tras las de Singapur y Malasia. Terminó la segunda sesión en el tercer escalón, a 0,189 de Leclerc, con Lewis Hamilton cuarto con Ferrari y George Russell quinto para Mercedes. Russell recibió una bandera de advertencia por un incidente con Leclerc que provocó que el monegasco se saliera de la pista al principio de la segunda sesión, pero los comisarios decidieron no tomar ninguna medida adicional. El vigente campeón de McLaren, Lando Norris, fue el tercero más rápido en la tanda inicial, a 0,245 del mejor tiempo, y luego quedó séptimo, por detrás de Liam Lawson, de Racing Bulls. "Creo que Lando es, sin duda, mucho más rápido de lo que indica su tiempo de vuelta", declaró el jefe de McLaren, Zak Brown, a la cadena Sky Sports. Gabriel Bortoleto, de Audi; Arvid Lindblad, de Racing Bulls; y Franco Colapinto, de Alpine, han recibido penalizaciones en la parrilla por cambios en sus unidades de potencia. Lindblad bajará cinco puestos desde la posición en la que se clasifique el sábado, Colapinto 10 y Bortoleto, 20. Williams pareció tener dificultades, con Carlos Sainz en el puesto 20 y Alex Albon en el 22 en la segunda sesión de entrenamientos. "El coche es un desastre ahora mismo, un desastre. No tengo confianza en la parte trasera", dijo Sainz por la radio del equipo. El circuito ha sido objeto de críticas por parte de algunos pilotos debido a lo accidentado que se ha vuelto. "Probablemente sea el circuito más bacheado que hemos tenido en lo que va de año. Es complicado, pero estoy seguro de que sabremos adaptarnos", declaró Pierre Gasly, de Alpine, a la cadena Sky Sports.

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル堅調、ユーロは仏情勢が重し 来週の中銀会合に注目
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２３日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。来週...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル堅調、ユーロは仏情勢が重し　来週の中銀会合に注目 4:30 配信

３月２４日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀が金融政策決定会合を開く。いずれも政策金利の据え置きが予想されているが、今後の金融政策の方向性の手がかりを示すか注目されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．１％安の１５６．９円。ただ、週間ベースでは円は対ドルで約０．７％上昇。９月中旬以来の大幅な上昇となる。ＭＵＦＧのシニア通貨アナリスト、リー・ハードマン氏は「リスク回避姿勢が強まる中、円買いが続いている」と述べた。

ユーロに対してはフランスの債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に拡大したことなどが重しになっており、ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１９１ドル。週初からは０．４３％下落した。

ユーロは対円でより大きく下落し、一時１７５．０８円と、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を更新。週初からは約１．１％下落した。

フランスでは１７日の抗議デモが過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展してから１週間が経過し、ヌニェス内相は暴力行為や略奪の再発防止に向け、２４日に全国で予定される抗議活動に７万人の警察官を動員すると発表。パリのルーブル美術館、オルセー美術館、オペラ座などの主要文化施設の一部が臨時休館となるほか、治安上の懸念からパリで予定されているサッカーフランス１部リーグの試合が２５日から２６日に延期されるなどの影響が出ている。

バノックバーン・グローバル・フォレックスの主席市場ストラテジスト、マーク・チャンドラー氏は「マクロン政権は社会不安の鎮静化に向けて軍の投入も辞さない姿勢を示しているが、週末にかけて抗議活動が一段と活発化する可能性が高い」と指摘。「欧州債券市場への圧力はこの日は幾分和らいだが、２３日に予定されているムーディーズによるフランス国債格付けの見直しが注目されている」と述べた。

終盤の取引で、主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％高の１０１．８２。

ＦＲＢの金融政策を巡っては、前日の株式相場急落を受け、１２月の会合での利上げ観測がやや後退したことがＬＳＥＧのデータで示された。ただ、ＦＦ金利先物市場では１２月利上げの確率はなお８１％と見込まれている。

ＥＣＢについては、１２月の理事会で利上げが決定される確率は６６％と織り込まれている。ラガルドＥＣＢ総裁が９月下旬にインフレに対し穏健な政策対応が適切との認識を示していることから、今後の金利見通しについて新たな示唆があるか注目されている。

日銀については、１２月の利上げの確率が６１％と織り込まれている。

item.title: Leclerc fastest for Ferrari in US GP Friday practice
item.description: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli was a close second ahead of a race that could make him Formula One's youngest champion.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Ferrari's Charles Leclerc led the way in US Grand Prix practice on Friday, with Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli a close second ahead of a race that could make him Formula One's youngest champion. Leclerc set the pace of one minute 35.291 seconds in a sunny second practice at Austin's Circuit of the Americas after also lapping fastest in the earlier session with a time of 1:36.052 in his upgraded car on a bumpy track. "It has been a very clean Friday for me, but the others seem to be gaining more than us from Friday to Saturday and seeing the little gap there is, it is not going to be so easy tomorrow," he said. Antonelli, the 20-year-old who must win on Sunday to have a first chance of taking the title, was fifth in session one when Red Bull's Max Verstappen was closest to 2024 winner Leclerc. The Italian, who complained about his seat moving, then improved to second place and ended the day 0.042 off the pace. "We didn't have the best FP1 session, with the car balance not in a great place," said Antonelli, who is 102 points clear of closest rival and teammate George Russell. "We were able to improve that for FP2 though and we took a good step forward." HAMILTON NOT COMFORTABLE ON BUMPY TRACK Verstappen, winner in Austin last year, is chasing his third successive victory after Singapore and Malaysia. He ended second practice as the third fastest and 0.189 off Leclerc with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton fourth and Russell fifth. "We tried a different direction with the set-up, but I wasn’t comfortable in the car, especially over the bumps," said Hamilton. "Charles showed there’s pace there, so we need to understand how we can get the car into a better place on my side." Russell had a black-and-white warning flag for an incident with Leclerc that led to the Monegasque going off track early in the second session, but stewards decided against any further action. McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris was third fastest, 0.245 off the pace, in first practice and then seventh later on and behind Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson. "I think Lando is definitely a lot quicker than his lap time," McLaren boss Zak Brown told Sky Sports television. "He didn't get his third sector in. His first two sectors were very strong. "So I think we are much quicker than we looked. I think Ferrari's lap time, Mercedes' lap time, there or thereabouts." Norris sounded less sure: "The pace is not bad. We seem a step away from Red Bull and Ferrari, probably Mercedes as well, but the car is very difficult to drive, too difficult to be consistent and get a nice feeling consistently." Teammate Oscar Piastri was eighth fastest, with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar ninth and Haas's Oliver Bearman completing the top 10. Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto, Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad and Alpine's Franco Colapinto all collected grid drops for changes to their power units. Lindblad will drop five places from wherever he qualifies on Saturday, Colapinto 10 places and Bortoleto 20. Williams looked to be struggling, with Carlos Sainz 20th and Alex Albon 22nd in practice two. "The car is a mess right now. It's a mess. I have no confidence in the rear," said Sainz over the team radio.

item.title: US Justice Dept sues to block possible Alaska election of Democrat to Senate
item.description: The Trump administration has sued Alaska to preemptively block the state from certifying the results of its US Senate race if the Republican incumbent candidate loses narrowly, saying voters could be confused because two Republicans on the ballot have almost identical names.
item.dc:creator: Jan Wolfe
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration has sued Alaska to preemptively block the state from certifying the results of its US Senate race if the Republican incumbent candidate loses narrowly, saying voters could be confused because two Republicans on the ballot have almost identical names. The Department of Justice's lawsuit, filed in federal court in Anchorage on Thursday, signals the willingness of President Donald Trump's administration to contest the results of the November 3 midterm elections that will decide control of the US Congress, where his fellow Republicans narrowly control both chambers. The administration has taken an increasingly aggressive approach to election oversight, pressing states for voter-registration data and arguing that stricter measures are needed to ensure public confidence in the vote. Critics, including Democratic and some Republican election officials, view the moves as federal overreach. Control of the Senate could come down to Alaska, where incumbent Republican Dan S. Sullivan is running a close race against Democrat Mary Peltola. The suit, which names the state and local election officials as defendants, takes issue with the presence of another contender in the race, another Republican named Dan J. Sullivan Jr, alleging he is running "with the intention of misleading supporters of Senator Sullivan into voting for him." The DOJ asks a judge to block the certification of an outcome "that may be impacted by voter confusion," so that there can be "an investigation to determine whether votes cast for Daniel J. Sullivan were meant to be cast for Senator Sullivan." Trump told reporters on Friday that he supported the lawsuit, saying "I'm the one that said do it." A DOJ spokesperson said in a statement that the agency is taking "necessary steps to ensure that this frivolous candidacy does not undermine the integrity of Alaska’s election or the will of its voters.” Election officials around the country have told Reuters they are preparing for potential federal interference in the elections, including legal challenges and disputes over voting that could disrupt certification of the results. Trump has a long history of challenging election outcomes and encouraging supporters to contest results he views as unfavorable. Alaska's other US senator, Senator Lisa Murkowski from Trump's Republican Party, said on Friday the Justice Department "should never have filed this lawsuit." Election law experts said the lawsuit has no merit and seeks relief not allowed under federal law. "In short, like many Department letters over the last few years, it is designed to win the press release rather than the litigation," wrote Notre Dame law professor Derek Muller in a blog post, adding that "the legal argument is one of the worst ones I’ve ever seen." Trump's administration "has absolutely no authority to tell Alaska when or how to certify the results of its Senate election," said David Becker of the Center for Election Innovation and Research, a nonpartisan group that advises election officials, adding that "this issue has already been fully litigated by Alaska's courts." The unelected Sullivan, a former US Forest Service worker and elementary school teacher, filed to run as a candidate on May 29, seeking to unseat Dan S. Sullivan and "put Alaska first," according to his campaign website, which advertised "Dan Sullivan Challenges Dan Sullivan for US Senate Seat." Dan J. Sullivan has denied in interviews with US news outlets that his aim is to cause confusion or divert votes from Dan S. Sullivan. The Alaska Supreme Court in June permitted the challenger Sullivan to appear on the ballot. He will appear without a party designation next to his name, while the senator will be listed as the Republican incumbent. Peltola, the Democratic candidate, told MS NOW on Friday that because of how the candidates are displayed on the ballot "there just isn't much room for confusion." The lawsuit is "sending a message that Dan Sullivan does not believe that Alaskans are sophisticated enough to know exactly who they're voting for," she added. Trump's [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"approval rating"] has fallen to a record low, hit by rising diesel and gasoline prices during the Iran war , which has proven deeply unpopular with voters. Public opinion polls suggest Republicans may lose control of one or both chambers of Congress, which would likely limit Trump's ability to enact some of his policy agenda in the final two years of his presidency.

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（23日）
item.description: ＜ロンドン株式市場＞ まちまちで取引を終えた。英政府予算案の発表を来週に控え、積極的な買い注文が手控えられた。原油の値上...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（23日） 3:46 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞　まちまちで取引を終えた。英政府予算案の発表を来週に控え、積極的な買い注文が手控えられた。原油の値上がりも相場の重荷となり、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続落。週間ベースでは１．７６％安と３週ぶりに反落した。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．１１％上昇と反発、週間は１．２１％下落した。    ＦＴＳＥ３５０種石油・ガス株指数は前日比３．８８％上昇した。    一方、航空宇宙・防衛株指数は４．６４％下落。エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは７．６％安だった。    銀行株指数は０．７８％、製薬・バイオテクノロジー株指数は１．０５％それぞれ下落。金価格の値下がりを受け、貴金属株指数は３．６５％値下がりした。    ９月の英小売売上高は前月から低下し、市場予想よりも低調だった。１０月の英消費者信頼感指数は大幅に悪化。物価動向を踏まえ、市場では１１月の英利上げが確実視されている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞　続落して取引を終えた。フランスでの抗議活動や政局への不安のほか、原油高が相場の重荷となり、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは１．３９％安と３週ぶりに反落した。    ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は前日比３．５９％安。フランスの高級ブランド、ケリングは１６．６％下落。中東情勢や中国での需要低迷が響き、主力ブランド、グッチの７─９月期の販売が減少した。一方、直近四半期決算の売上高が市場予想を上回ったフランスの化粧品大手ロレアルは５．６％上昇した。    ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は３．７５％安。決算を発表したフランスの航空機エンジンメーカーのサフランは１０．０％下落した。    直近四半期が営業赤字となったスウェーデンの自動車メーカー、ボルボ・カーは２４．２％安。約２５００人の人員削減計画を発表した。    欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は来週、理事会を開く。市場では政策金利を据え置くとの観測が強い。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　フランス国債利回り上昇が一服した。この日は、仏１０年国債利回りは５ｂｐ低下の５．０４％となった。    週間ベースでは２７ｂｐ近く上昇しており、２０２６年５月下旬以来の大幅な上昇を記録した。ベルギー国債利回りは１９ｂｐ近く、イタリア国債利回りも１１ｂｐ、それぞれ上昇した。これに対し、ドイツとオランダの１０年債利回りはそれぞれ７ｂｐ、６ｂｐ低下した。    ２３日は今週の流れが一部反転し、ドイツとオランダの利回りはともに２ｂｐ上昇し、それぞれ３．３５％、３．４６％となった。    来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、日銀、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）など主要中銀の金融政策決定が相次ぐ。    ＥＣＢは他の２中銀と同様、政策金利を据え置くと予想されている。このため投資家は、ラガルド総裁が見通しについて何を語るかに加え、フランス国債の緊張が市場の火種になり得るかどうかについての発言に注目することになる。    ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、短期金融市場は２３日、１２月までに利上げが行われる確率を再び約８０％に織り込んでいた。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

item.title: イラン、海底ケーブル攻撃準備 米・イスラエル再攻撃なら＝治安高官
item.description: [ドバイ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ　２３日　ロイター] - 米国とイスラエルがイランを再び攻撃した場合、イランがペルシャ湾の海底通信ケーブルを標的とする攻撃の詳細な計画を策定していることがイラン治安当局高官２人の話で分かった。

イラン当局者はこれまでも、米国との外交交渉が決裂し新たな戦闘が発生すれば、海底ケーブルが攻撃対象になり得ると警告。匿名を条件に取材に応じた２人の高官は、攻撃の具体的な手法や実施場所について明らかにしなかったが、このうち１人は、インターネット接続を含む通信の混乱を長期化させるため、攻撃後の修復作業を妨害することを目指す考えを示した。

同高官はロイターに対し「イランが攻撃されれば、もはやレッドライン（越えてはならない一線）は存在しない。海底ケーブルから軍事基地まで、秘密基地も含めて標的になり得る」と指摘。米国は「火遊びをしてはならない」とし、イランは海底ケーブルの位置を完全に把握しており、容易に破壊できると主張した。

海底ケーブルを巡っては、イランのイスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）のジャバニ政治担当副司令官が２１日、イランのインフラが攻撃を受けた場合、ホルムズ海峡の海底に敷設された主要なインターネット通信ケーブル７本を標的にする可能性があると述べている。

国連機関の国際電気通信連合（ＩＴＵ）によると、海底ケーブルは世界のインターネット通信量の約９９％を担っている。ただ、通信調査会社テレジオグラフィーの調査責任者アラン・モールディン氏は、ホルムズ海峡を通過する国際通信帯域は全体の１％未満にとどまるため、イランによる攻撃があっても世界全体に及ぶ影響は限定される可能性があると指摘している。

イラン治安当局高官の発言について、米国務省とイラン外務省からコメントは得られていない。湾岸諸国も現時点でコメントしていない。

item.title: Mark Cuban says AI hack agents are like cockroaches, but can be controlled
item.description: Billionaire entrepreneur Mark Cuban said on Friday that he is "not a doomer" about artificial intelligence and that companies should be able to use the technology to protect themselves from AI-driven hacks by agents that he compared to cockroaches.
item.dc:creator: Caroline Humer
item.content:encoded: Billionaire entrepreneur Mark Cuban said on Friday that he is "not a doomer" about artificial intelligence and that companies should be able to use the technology to protect themselves from AI-driven hacks by agents that he compared to cockroaches. "It's like the cockroach thing, right? You build a new house, you get the guys to come out and spray... the one thing I don't want is cockroaches in my house ever. But the cockroaches find a way to get in because there's zillions of them, right? And then if there's one gets in, there's more that are going to get in, and that's kind of the way AI works," Cuban said, speaking at Reuters Total Health. "It's all brute force acts, and if it's brute force on that side with the bad guys, you can also use brute force with the good guys," he said. Cuban, famous for his role on business reality show "Shark Tank" and his involvement in the Dallas Mavericks NBA team, ventured into healthcare when he started the online pharmacy Cost Plus Drug Company in 2022 with a standard pricing scheme: the cost it pays for the drug, plus 15%. In May, Cost Plus signed on with TrumpRx.gov, a website created by the Trump administration selling discounted weight-loss drugs. But the company has also moved into manufacturing. In 2025, it began making sterile injectable drugs typically used in hospitals in its own compounding manufacturing facility. Cuban said the company has built smaller, tractor-trailer-sized manufacturing facilities he calls "pods" that can be used separately or together to manufacture many kinds of drugs, including generics and treatments for rare diseases. He said the pods would eventually be Cost Plus Drugs' biggest business and would allow medicines to be manufactured closer to where they are needed in the event of a disaster, because they're portable. One holdup, Cuban said, has been getting regulators from the US Food and Drug Administration to sign off on the pods. "We're talking to the FDA to try to get approval," he said without outlining the complications. "They're working hard to try to figure it out." Cuban campaigned for Democratic presidential nominee Kamala Harris in 2024 and has supported Democratic candidate James Talarico for US Senate this year in Texas. He said two items he believes the US government should immediately put in place to help lower healthcare costs would be that all payments made out of pocket should count towards patients' deductibles and that taxpayer-funded health contracts should be public without redactions. Still, Cuban said he did not believe Democrats were necessarily better than Republicans on healthcare. "None of them know what they're doing," he said.

item.title: トランプ氏、カナダ産農林業製品の一部関税撤廃 中間選挙控え国境州に配慮
item.description: [ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２３日、一部のカナダ産農林業製品に対する５０％関税を撤廃する大統領令に署名した。中間選挙を前にメイン州選出の共和党議員の要請を受けたもので、米農業関連企業の負担軽減につながる可能性がある。

今回の措置は、厳しい再選戦を戦っているメイン州選出のスーザン・コリンズ上院議員（共和党）が同州の企業や農家に影響を及ぼしている関税問題への対応をホワイトハウスに求めたことを受けたもの。ホワイトハウスによると、合板、一部の紙製品、特定の機械や冷却設備、梱包用の木箱や容器などが関税撤廃の対象になる。

トランプ氏は８月、カナダとの関税協議が決裂したことを受け、カナダからの２００億ドル相当の輸入品に対し５０％の関税を課すと発表していた。

コリンズ議員は、今回の措置でメイン州のブルーベリー、ジャガイモ、リンゴ、海藻の生産者が恩恵を受けると指摘。声明で「これらの生産者は州経済にとって不可欠な存在で、地方や沿岸部の地域社会を支えている」とし、「多くの農家や生産業者はカナダから調達する特殊な機械や包装資材などに依存している。こうした製品は米国内では入手できない場合があるほか、代替には多額の費用がかかる」とした。

カナダとの国境に近い米北部のメイン州やミシガン州などは関税措置の影響を大きく受けており、１１月３日の中間選挙に向け一部の共和党候補は難しい対応を迫られている。特にメイン州とミシガン州の経済は自動車部品や木材、果実収穫用機器など幅広い分野でカナダ経済と深く結び付いており、関税政策を巡る政治的な重要性が一段と高まっている。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : US Senator Marsha Blackburn, a Tennessee Republican, on Friday raised concerns about Facebook parent Meta Platforms' plan to update its commercial terms, saying it could harm businesses and creators. Blackburn, who is chair of the Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Privacy, Technology and the Law, said the updated terms "indicate Meta is attempting to exploit American creators and businesses by granting itself sweeping authority to scrape content from any website associated with Facebook and Instagram business accounts."  Earlier on Friday, Meta said it would delay the implementation of updated commercial terms from October 30 until November 20, so it can address concerns from publishers and digital advertisers. EU and UK antitrust authorities have received complaints about the new commercial terms, which publishers and digital advertisers said would give Meta unlimited rights to use their content for its AI services. Meta has rejected the claims.

Blackburn said that Meta previously revised its terms to remove an explicit reference to AI training but said the changes did not go far enough. She added that the revised language authorizes extensive scraping of external websites and permits Meta to “develop” its business products with collected content. "Without clear restrictions on how that information may be used, including whether it may be incorporated into AI systems, Meta’s revisions offer little assurance that creators’ intellectual property will be protected," Blackburn said. She added: "This is particularly troubling for American news publishers, creators, and small businesses that rely on Meta’s platforms to reach their audiences and customers." Asked for comment on Blackburn's letter, Meta on Friday noted it had delayed the change and said the revised terms apply only to its ads and business products and that it is not changing how it uses web crawlers. "These updates don't give us new rights to supersede such preferences and this isn’t about scraping news sites," the company said, noting that "content owners will still be able to use robots.txt to signal preferences." Publishers worldwide are ramping up fights with AI companies using their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair-use arguments. "Meta must withdraw the updated Commercial Terms and come to the table to protect the content of creators and publishers across the country," Blackburn said. "American creators and small businesses are not a free source of content for Meta to exploit."

Source: Reuters

item.title: Trump ends tariffs on some Canadian products, as Senator Collins faces close race
item.description: With an incumbent Maine US senator from his own party locked in a tight reelection battle, President Donald Trump signed an order on Friday to remove 50% tariffs on some Canadian agricultural and forestry products in a move that could benefit companies from the northern state.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: With an incumbent Maine US senator from his own party locked in a tight reelection battle, President Donald Trump signed an order on Friday to remove 50% tariffs on some Canadian agricultural and forestry products in a move that could benefit companies from the northern state. The Republican president's hefty tariffs on Canada have caused friction with the US neighbor to the north while creating problems for American businesses in Maine and other states that rely on certain Canadian goods. With the November 3 US midterm elections looming and Republicans fighting to retain control of both houses of Congress, [USN:L6N3YF150 TEXT:"Senator Susan Collins"] had urged the White House to address tariffs on products affecting companies and farmers in Maine, a state that borders Canada. COLLINS, IN TIGHT MAINE RACE, PRAISES TARIFF RELIEF Trump's order exempted plywood sheets, some paper products, certain machinery and refrigeration equipment, and packing crates and boxes, as well as fresh and dried seaweed, the White House said. The changes take effect on October 30, four days before the election. Trump added a number of Canadian products to the 50% tariff list to offset the tariff relief provided in his order, including carpets, paints, waste, shampoos, cocoa powder, wooden coffins, ice cream sticks, air-conditioning machines, chest freezers, archery equipment and canoes. Collins said the relief would aid Maine's blueberry, potato, apple and seaweed producers. "These producers are a vital part of our state's economy and support our rural and coastal communities," Collins said. "Many of our farmers and growers rely on specialized equipment, packaging materials and other products from Canada that are either unavailable from American suppliers or cannot be replaced without incurring significant expense." [USN:L1N43R04Q TEXT:"Democrat Troy Jackson"] is seeking to oust Collins in a race that polls indicate is very close. The two sparred over tariffs at an October 6 debate. "Trump's trade wars have made life harder and more expensive for Mainers," Jackson said on Friday after Trump's action. "Susan Collins enabled this chaos, voted to confirm the people behind it and now wants credit for bringing a cup of water to put out the fire." Collins did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Jackson's remarks. Trump in August imposed 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian imports, which took effect after talks between the two countries collapsed. Canada retaliated in September with tariffs ranging from 15% to 50% on $20 billion in US goods. Canada and the United States have been in a standoff over the tariffs since Trump imposed them. Trump asserted on Friday that Canada is working on a deal. BORDER-STATE REPUBLICANS SEEK TO STRIKE BALANCE Republican candidates in northern US border states most affected by the tariffs, including Maine and Michigan, are trying to strike a balance between appealing to Trump's conservative base and winning over independent voters. In a statement concerning Trump's action on Friday, White House spokesperson Matthew Middleton said the president "continues to address Canada's discriminatory treatment of US commerce" and that the new moves are "further refining the scope" of the previously announced tariffs. Dominic LeBlanc, Canada's minister responsible for trade with the US, said Ottawa was assessing Trump's latest tariff change. "Canada stands ready to work constructively and in good faith towards a more mutually beneficial trading relationship that respects Canada's interests," LeBlanc said in a statement. The economies of Michigan and Maine have long been intertwined with that of Canada, covering everything from auto parts to lumber to fruit-picking equipment. Republicans may need to win closely contested Senate races in both states in order to maintain their slim majority in the chamber. "Trump's desperate, 11th-hour attempt to save Susan Collins' political career is an admission that American voters are rejecting his toxic tariff policies," Senator Ron Wyden of Oregon, the top Democrat on the Senate Finance Committee, said in a statement on Friday. "No one will forget how Trump raised prices on thousands of products American families need by slapping trade taxes on goods from around the world." Michigan US Senate candidate Mike Rogers, a Republican who previously called for ending the trade war with Canada, praised Trump for imposing tariffs on Canadian trash. "If you’re going to be putting tariffs on anything from Canada, it ought to be the damn trash they’ve been dumping in our state for decades," Rogers said. Trump's threat in September to block Canadian jet maker Bombardier (BBDb.TO) from the US market became a political issue in Kansas, where the company employs 1,500 workers in Wichita. Trump dropped the threatened ban this week after calls from Kansas lawmakers including Republican Senator Roger Marshall, who is also locked in a tough reelection race.

item.title: スターリンク利用に問題なら解決へ、トランプ氏が表明
item.description: [ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２３日、ウクライナで衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の利用に依然として問題があるなら、自ら解決すると述べた。

ホワイトハウスで記者団に対し、この問題についてスペースＸのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）とは話していないが、利用上の問題が解消されなければ同氏と話すとし、「問題があるなら、私が解決する」と明言した。

ウクライナ当局者は２３日、国内でスターリンクの速度制限が続いていると述べた。サービスが完全に復旧したとするトランプ氏の先の発言と食い違っている。

トランプ氏は「イーロンは決して間違ったことはしない。私は彼をよく知っている。彼は公正な人物だ。ウクライナが民間企業と話し合っているというのは異例の状況だが、彼が間違ったことをすることはない」と語った。

item.title: 中国、宇宙での軍拡競争に反対 探査の権利保障訴え＝文書
item.description: [北京 ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京 ２３日 ロイター] - 中国外務省は２３日、宇宙での軍拡競争に反対すると表明した。宇宙の探査や平和目的での利用を呼びかけ、すべての国による宇宙の探査や利用の権利が保障されるべきだと訴えている。

外務省が公表した宇宙を巡る中国政府の立場を記した文書によると、宇宙の「武器化」や軍事化のほか、「他国の主権や安全保障、開発上の利益を損なう活動」に利用することに反対し、「宇宙での軍拡競争リスクや戦場化しようとする動きが、宇宙の安全に対する最大の脅威と課題になっている」と言及した。中国は「宇宙の軍拡競争を防ぐためにあらゆる努力を払う」ことを求めていると説明している。

中国は商業的な宇宙活動の規制を求め、宇宙関連の経済の発展を奨励すると主張。商業的な宇宙活動は「他国の正当な権利や利益を侵害してはならず、武力紛争や内政に違法に介入することは避けるべきだ」とした。

item.title: 米ロウクライナ和平協議、11月前半にアブダビで開催へ＝ゼレンスキー大統領
item.description:
Andrea Shalal Olena Harmash
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrea Shalal　Olena Harmash

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２３日、ウクライナ、ロシア、米国の和平交渉担当者が、１１月前半にアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビで実務レベルの協議を開くことで合意したと明らかにした。その後に３カ国の首脳会談が行われることを期待していると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏はシンクタンクのハドソン研究所にビデオリンクを通じて「計画では１１月前半、もちろんできるだけ早期に会合を開く予定だ」と語った。その上で、今月開催が見込まれていた同様の会合が実現しなかったことに言及し、多くはロシア次第であるとの見解を示した。

その上で、実務協議の後に３カ国の首脳会談を開催することが極めて重要だと強調した。

ゼレンスキー氏は、ロシアのプーチン大統領と今週会談したトランプ大統領の娘婿クシュナー氏、ウィットコフ中東担当特使と２３日に協議を行ったと説明。和平合意にはウクライナに対する強力な安全保障の保証と、ウクライナ軍を維持するための１０年間の資金拠出が必要になるとの見方を示した。

item.title: Judge puts off decision on Charlie Kirk murder trial date, media reports
item.description: A Utah judge on Friday said he needed more time to decide when to start the trial of Tyler Robinson, the man accused of killing prominent right-wing activist Charlie Kirk more than a year ago, media reported.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Hay
item.content:encoded: A Utah judge on Friday said he needed more time to decide when to start the trial of Tyler Robinson, the man accused of killing prominent [USN:L2N3UX161 TEXT:"right-wing activist Charlie Kirk"] more than a year ago, media reported. At a hearing in Provo, Utah, District Court Judge Tony Graf heard arguments from defense lawyers, prosecutors and a lawyer for Kirk's widow, Erika Kirk, before saying he needed to consider their positions. He set a new hearing for November 9, television station KUTV reported. Robinson, 23, has pleaded not guilty to seven counts, including aggravated murder, for allegedly shooting Kirk as he held one of his trademark debates at Utah Valley University in Orem. Robinson's lawyers expect a six-to-seven-month trial. Robinson's attorneys had asked for a late 2029 trial to give them time to challenge Utah's request for the death penalty, gather additional evidence and seek a change of venue, among other issues, according to a scheduling memo. Prosecutors, meanwhile, sought a date of January 31, 2028 to start what they expect to be a 17-week trial, according to their scheduling memo . In a separate filing , Erika Kirk said the defense request was "grossly out of line with comparable cases" and requested the trial start no later than October 4, 2027. Shortly before Friday's hearing, President Donald Trump, with whom Kirk had been allied, slammed Graf's handling of the case in a social media post , saying it should be tried within a month and Graf was asking "questions that people already know the answer to." Kirk was a polarizing figure in US politics. He was admired by conservatives for mobilizing young voters around his Christian and right-wing views. Opponents criticized his rhetoric on immigration, race, gender and other social issues. Prosecutors [USN:L6N43V09L TEXT:"allege"] Robinson targeted Kirk for his opposition to gay marriage and transgender rights. Defense attorney Richard Novak has said Kirk spoke "hatefully" about people who did not have traditional gender identities or were not heterosexual, but there was no evidence Robinson opposed those views.

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Oct 23 : Major stock indexes ended lower on Friday even as tech shares mostly steadied, while Brent crude oil rose to its highest level in nearly six months after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia. The Nasdaq eased. European shares also ended lower. An index of semiconductors rose 0.4 per cent. On Thursday, it posted its biggest daily percentage drop since June after a report from Meta Platforms reignited worries about the AI trade. The S&P 500 technology index was also up 0.4 per cent. The S&P 500 energy sector rose 2.5 per cent, hitting a record high. Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia fanned fears over further disruption to energy supplies from the Middle East, where United Arab Emirates authorities also reported an oil spill.

Brent crude futures settled at $116.72 a barrel, up $3.55 or 3.14 per cent, their highest since April 29. US West Texas Intermediate crude closed at $103.27 a barrel, up $3.80 or 3.8 per cent. Brent finished the week up 6 per cent and WTI ended 2.3 per cent higher. US Treasury yields rose after the benchmark 10-year yield posted on Thursday its biggest one-day drop in nearly four years.  "There are still all these headwinds in terms of sticky inflation," said JoAnne Bianco, partner and senior investment strategist at BondBloxx Investment Management in Chicago. The 10-year yield remained under 5 per cent as concerns about the durability of a rally in AI-related stocks lingered. The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note was up 3.7 basis points at 4.99 per cent. AI SHARES MIXED Investor focus remains on the earnings season, with robust corporate profit growth underpinning gains for major equity indexes this year. Next week, about one-third of S&P 500 companies report quarterly results, including Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon, three AI hyperscalers whose capital spending forecasts will be closely watched on Wall Street. Meta shares ended down 1 per cent, while Microsoft was up 0.7 per cent. Shares of Alphabet and Amazon eased. "After Meta's report, there's still anxiety over the AI trade to a certain extent," said Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B. Riley Wealth in Boston.  Investors also digested other corporate earnings news. American Express shares fell 3.7 per cent after it reported results and its CEO said the company had good momentum, but needed to become a more "agile and efficient" organization. Telecom company shares, including Verizon, dropped after a report that SpaceX was in talks with cellular infrastructure companies about launching a US wireless carrier program. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 652.82 points, or 1.23 per cent, to 52,215.16; the S&P 500 lost 39.75 points, or 0.52 per cent, to 7,623.68 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 53.52 points, or 0.21 per cent, to 25,955.34. For the week, the S&P 500 fell 0.5 per cent and the Nasdaq dropped 0.7 per cent. The blue-chip Dow rose 0.4 per cent, notching its third straight weekly gain. MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe fell 3.96 points, or 0.35 per cent, to 1,118.97. Asia's bourses steadied overnight, with South Korea's KOSPI ending its session higher after shedding as much as 4 per cent earlier. EURO FALLS The euro fell and was down for the week, while euro zone bonds stabilized after recent volatility. The euro has been hit by concerns about unrest in France and the country's budget problems. France will deploy 70,000 police backed by specialist units for protests on Saturday, Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said. The euro was last down 0.21 per cent at $1.1191. European stocks recorded their steepest weekly loss since early September. The pan-European STOXX 600 index fell 0.31 per cent to close at 635.77 points. For the week, the benchmark is down about 1.4 per cent. French yields, which were down 5 basis points at 5.04 per cent, have risen nearly 27 bps this week, the most of any major euro zone country and the most in a week since late May.  A selloff in French government bonds this week pushed the country's debt risk premium to its highest level since the euro zone sovereign debt crisis in 2011.

Source: Reuters

Oct 23 : US telecom stocks declined on Friday after a report that SpaceX was seeking thousands of cell sites for a fourth wireless carrier, fueling concerns over fresh competition. Elon Musk's rocket and space technology company was in talks to access at least 80,000 cell sites to build its wireless carrier from scratch, Bloomberg News reported late on Thursday, citing sources familiar with the matter. AT&T fell 5.6 per cent to a more than three-month low, Verizon lost 1.6 per cent and T-Mobile shed 5 per cent.  Germany's Deutsche Telekom, which holds an over 50 per cent stake in T-Mobile, lost 3.2 per cent.

"The competitive impact may still be years away, but anticipation alone, reinforced by each successive spectrum and infrastructure move, is likely to remain an overhang on sector sentiment," Bernstein analysts said in a note. Tower operators and SpaceX did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The report comes weeks after SpaceX acquired low-band spectrum to advance its carrier plans, mounting a direct, orbital challenge to legacy wireless giants in the US and sending AT&T and Verizon shares to their worst one-day falls in more than two decades. Bernstein analysts said that an MVNO (mobile virtual network operator) deal with SpaceX may not appeal to telecom operators, but a unified stance against one has done little to lift sentiment, leaving carriers to reassess their options. SpaceX's Starlink has been generating revenue from internet services in sparsely populated and rural areas, but becoming a true rival to major carriers will require years of work and a terrestrial network. Tower operator Crown Castle, however, surged 11.6 per cent after the report identified it as one of the cellular infrastructure companies SpaceX was in talks with.  Other operators also rose, with American Tower up 4.9 per cent and SBA Communications adding 4.6 per cent.  Shares of SpaceX rose 1.7 per cent.

Source: Reuters

Oct 23 : Telecom giants AT&T and T-Mobile are investing to safeguard customer data and network infrastructure from new cybersecurity threats as AI integration ramps up, though fully autonomous networks remain years away, company executives told Reuters. As AI agents automate workflows and data analysis, with declining human intervention, cybersecurity concerns are growing across industries over access to sensitive information and connected software. For telecom operators, which manage vast amounts of customer data and critical communications infrastructure, vulnerabilities in AI systems or third-party software could extend from data breaches to network disruptions. "Yes, we are increasing our investments in how we monitor and react," T-Mobile's Chief Technology Officer John Saw told the Reuters Global Markets Forum. The company simultaneously works with vendors to ensure security holes are closed as soon as possible, he added.

The Bellevue, Washington-based wireless carrier has suffered several data breaches, including incidents in 2021 and 2023, cumulatively impacting over 100 million customer accounts. It has agreed to various settlements with consumers and the Federal Communications Commission involving cybersecurity penalties and investments. AT&T, meanwhile, warned that third-party software providers and AI agents pose cybersecurity risks that extend beyond operators' own networks. "There (are) industry problems, not things that AT&T can solve by itself," CTO Jeremy Legg said, questioning if the open-source community followed comparable security standards. The Texas-based company has deployed AI governance controls such as encryption, multi-factor authentication and human oversight of data access. It is also working to verify whether third-party AI agents seeking access to customer accounts are acting on behalf of legitimate customers, the company said. AI has automated aspects of network management for telecom operators, but handing over entire networks to AI-driven autonomous systems is still "years away," Legg said, as human intervention is still required to solve complex network problems. For instance, AT&T has automated some tasks such as analyzing trouble tickets to identify potential fixes and, in some cases, automatically implementing repairs. T-Mobile, meanwhile, uses AI to automatically adjust cell-site antennas when nearby sites go down to compensate for coverage gaps. During Winter Storm Fern in January, T-Mobile's self-organizing network, or SON, restored coverage to about 66 per cent of customers within an hour and 90 per cent within eight hours, with most customers regaining service before power was restored, Saw said. MILAN, Oct 23 : As the financial system turns increasingly digital, banks must resist the temptation to delay investments until they know which technology will prevail, a senior Bank of Italy official said on Friday. • Waiting could help lenders save money in the short term, but it "also has costs when it delays learning or the creation of future opportunities," Bank of Italy Deputy Governor Chiara Scotti said in the text of a speech • Scotti said banks should target investments that lend themselves to usefulness across different scenarios and support institutions' learning process • Only by experimenting can banks understand how best to adapt the new digital technologies to their business, she said

item.title: Bayern coach Kompany taken to hospital after collapsing during training session
item.description: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany was rushed to hospital on Friday after collapsing during a training session, the German champions said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany was rushed to hospital on Friday after collapsing during a training session, the German champions said. The Belgian had been [USN:L6N46610X TEXT:"nursing"] a virus in recent days and had missed some of his team's training sessions. "On Friday, Vincent Kompany required medical attention after collapsing during a training session for Bayern’s reserve team," the club said. "The head coach of the professional squad had been observing the second team’s session." "Kompany is currently undergoing a thorough examination in the hospital and will remain under medical care. For the time being, his coaching staff will manage all training and match-related operations." The Bundesliga leaders, who drew 2-2 at home against Arsenal in the Champions League earlier this week, are due to travel to Freiburg on Sunday. “Vincent Kompany’s health is our top priority," said Max Eberl, Bayern's Board Member for Sport. "At Bayern, we will do everything we can to ensure he makes a speedy recovery." "Vinnie is receiving all the necessary medical care and support, and he will be given as much time as he needs. Everyone at FC Bayern wishes Vinnie a quick recovery.”

item.title: Carney dismisses US accusations of Canadian election interference
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney on Friday dismissed accusations that Canada planned to interfere in next month's US midterm elections and said he was disappointed in comments made by the American ambassador.
item.dc:creator: Maria Cheng
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Mark Carney on Friday dismissed accusations that Canada planned to interfere in next month's US midterm elections and said he was disappointed in comments made by the American ambassador. Carney's remarks underline the chilly state of bilateral relations since Canada [USN:L1N44I0GP TEXT:"walked"] away from talks on a possible trade deal in late August, citing unreasonable US demands. The US embassy in Canada on Wednesday said Ottawa "brushes off concerns about potential interference in US elections, even as its ministers and premiers openly describe plans to influence American politics." A week earlier, Ambassador Pete Hoekstra had told a podcast that his message to Canadians was to "keep your nose out of American politics." Carney said Canada had no intention of interfering in the November 3 elections. "There is no merit to these claims," he told reporters during an official visit to Turkey. "I'm disappointed their envoy sees that as his role to make these suggestions." US President Donald Trump has imposed a raft of tariffs on imports from Canada and frequently suggests he could annex the country. His approval rating at home is at record lows, and polls suggest his Republican Party will do [USN:L1N4670HR TEXT:"badly"] in the midterms that will determine control of the US Congress. Asked whether he thought Trump could use poor election results as an excuse to impose more tariffs on Canada, Carney said he did not think that was likely. The trade talks that collapsed in August had been intended in part to cut some of the tariffs. Carney reiterated that Canada was in no rush to sign a deal and, for the first time, suggested Ottawa might wait till Trump's term was over. "If it has to be months from now or longer than that, or another administration before a proper deal comes into place, we will do that," he said. The trip to Turkey is part of a campaign to reduce Canada's heavy reliance on the US economy. "It's absolutely clear where I stand, where Canada stands, where Canadians stand. We will never be the 51st state. We are going our own way," Carney said.

item.title: アメックス、26年利益見通し上方修正 世界で5％人員削減へ
item.description:
Manya Saini Arasu Kannagi Basil
[２３日 ロイター] - 米クレジットカード大手アメリ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アメックス、26年利益見通し上方修正　世界で5％人員削減へ 0:36 配信

2026年7月17日に撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo/File Photo

Manya Saini　Arasu Kannagi Basil

[２３日 ロイター] - 米クレジットカード大手アメリカン・エキスプレス（アメックス）は２３日、２０２６年通期の利益予想を市場予想を上回る水準に引き上げた。また、事業再編の一環として世界の従業員の５％に当たる約３５００人を削減する計画を発表した。

スティーブン・スクエリ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はアナリストに対し、業績は好調に推移しているものの、より「機動的で効率的な」組織になる必要があると説明した。

通期の調整後１株利益予想は１７．６０─１７．９０ドル。レンジの中央値は、ＬＳＥＧがまとめた市場予想の１７．６３ドルを上回る。

アメックスは、信用スコアが高く可処分所得の多い富裕層を顧客として取り込むことで、経済全体の減速や不確実性の影響を受けにくい事業基盤を築いてきた。２６年の業績は好調に推移している。

ただ、マーケティング支出を増やし、新たな特典を付けてカードを刷新したことから、投資家は経費の増加を注視している。

第３・四半期（９月３０日まで）の連結経費は前年同期比９％増の１４５億ドルだった。

第３・四半期の調整後１株利益は４．６８ドルと、市場予想の約４．４８ドルを大幅に上回った。

第３・四半期の旅行・娯楽関連のカード利用額は前年同期比１０％増加した。航空分野が１３％増、飲食店分野が９％増となり、全体をけん引した。

アメックスが発行する全カードの利用総額を示す「ビルド・ビジネス」は、第３・四半期に８％増の４５４０億ドルとなった。売上高は９％増の２０１億ドルだった。

アプタス・キャピタル・アドバイザーズの株式部門責任者兼ポートフォリオマネジャー、デービッド・ワグナー氏は「富裕層の支出は底堅く、この顧客層に経済的な負担が増している兆候はない。低所得層の消費者とは対照的だ」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：米20年国債は廃止されるのか　利払い費増大で議論高まる アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 10/24(土) 0:36 ロイター

WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : US President Donald Trump said on Friday that if there was still a problem with access to Starlink communication systems in Ukraine, he would get it straightened out. Trump told reporters at the White House that he had not spoken to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk about the matter but, if access was not fixed, he would speak to him. "If there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out," Trump said. The caps have been in place since October 13 as relations between Kyiv and Washington deteriorated Ukrainian officials said on Friday that speed restrictions on Starlink communication systems in Ukraine remained in place, contradicting Trump's previous statement that the services had been fully restored. "Elon will never do anything wrong. I know him very well. He's a fair person, and you know it's an unusual situation where they're talking to a private company. But he's not going to do anything that's wrong," Trump said.

item.title: トランプ氏、イラン戦争「速やかに終結可能」 自然に収束か見極めも
item.description: [ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２３日、米国はイランとの戦争を速やかに終結させることができるとの見方を示した。一方で、米政府が早期の決着を目指すべきか、紛争が徐々に収束するのを待つべきかについては疑問を呈した。

トランプ氏は「われわれは非常に迅速に終わらせることができる」と述べた上で、「終わらせたいのか、それとも自然に収束するのを待つべきか、それが問題だ」と語った。

また、米国はイランの石油を全て奪取することができるとも主張した。

item.title: ロ中銀、政策金利14％に据え置き インフレ見通し引き上げ
item.description:
Elena Fabrichnaya Gleb Bryanski
[モスクワ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Elena Fabrichnaya　Gleb Bryanski

[モスクワ ２３日 ロイター] - ロシア中央銀行は２３日、主要政策金利を１４％に据え置くことを決定した。物価上昇圧力とインフレ期待が高止まりしており、９月会合に続いて金利を維持した。２０２６年のインフレ率見通しについては７．１─７．６％と、従来の６．０─７．０％から引き上げた。

今回の据え置き決定は、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト２０人の予想と一致した。中銀は２７年の平均政策金利の見通しを１２．５─１３．５％と、従来の１０．５─１２．５％から引き上げた。

ロシアでは、今年に入ってウクライナによるドローン攻撃で多くの製油所が操業停止し、ガソリンやディーゼル燃料（軽油）の価格が上昇。公共料金の値上げもあり、インフレ率が高止まりしている。中銀は、２７年に目標とする４％に落ち着くと見込んでいる。

中銀は「特定の分野での一時的な生産能力の低下の影響があり、基礎的な物価上昇率は鈍化していない」との見方を示した。燃料価格が物価動向全般に影響を与える一方、「特定分野の生産能力の長期的な縮小」がインフレリスクにつながると言及した。

ロシアの財政赤字は２６年に国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比３．２％に悪化する見通し。軍事費がかさみ歳出は１３％増える見込み。２６年の経済成長率見通しは０．６％で、高金利環境で経済成長が抑制され、政府の債務返済に影響が出る可能性がある。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ミシガン大消費者信頼感10月確報は48.0、中間選挙控え過去最低に迫る 0:06 配信

米ニューヨーク市で食料品の買い物をしている人々。８月撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[２３日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が２３日発表した１０月の消費者信頼感指数の確報値は４８．０と、９月の４８．１から小幅低下し、過去最低に迫る水準となった。生活費を主な争点とする米中間選挙を目前に控え、中東紛争に伴う物価上昇が家計の景況感を悪化させていることを示した。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は４６．３。１０月の速報値も４６．３だった。

１０月は、イラン戦争開始から間もない５月に記録した過去最低の４４．８に次ぐ、調査開始以来２番目に低い水準となった。消費者調査ディレクターのジョアン・スー氏は「購買力が依然として、消費者の景況感を左右する主な要因となっている」と指摘。「信頼感は現在、１年前より１０％低く、イラン紛争直前の２月よりも１５％低い」と述べた。

支持政党別では、重要な浮動票層を構成する「無党派」と自認する回答者が景況感の悪化を主導した。無党派層では信頼感指数は４２．４と、９月の４７．７から低下し、過去最低を記録した５月の４０．６をわずかに上回る水準にとどまった。一方、民主党支持者と共和党支持者では信頼感指数は改善した。

１年後のインフレ期待は４．７％と、９月の４．６％から小幅上昇した。米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争開始前の２月時点では３．４％だった。

５年後のインフレ期待は３．５％。９月は３．４％だった。

調査によると、今年は無党派層および共和党支持者の間で、物価高が個人の家計を圧迫していると指摘する回答が著しく増えた。１月以降、インフレ圧力が家計状況を悪化させていると指摘する無党派層の数は２７％増加、共和党支持者では５２％も急増した。一方、民主党支持者では１５％増にとどまった。

株式市場へのエクスポージャーがない、または限定的な世帯も、年初に比べて物価高が家計の重しになっていると指摘する頻度が高まっている。これらの世帯は、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブームへの期待を受けここ最近まで急上昇していた株式市場の恩恵を十分に受けていない。

前出のスー氏は「消費者は概してインフレの加速を予想しており、今年のインフレ期待の上昇は、特定の政治的立場に限られたものではない」と指摘。「経済に対する悲観的な見方にもかかわらず、消費者支出全体が比較的底堅く推移しているという事実は、警戒すべきもう一つの理由となる。消費の一部が現在、将来の物価上昇を回避するための予防的な支出を反映しているのであれば、ディスインフレ（インフレ鈍化）の達成は一段と困難になる可能性がある」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ムスリム候補者をやり玉に、米中間選挙でイスラム教を争点化する共和党 アングル：米中間選挙が事実上の最終盤入り、トランプ氏の共和党に暗雲 焦点：共和党、初の中間選挙全国大会を来月開催　トランプ支持再燃狙う アングル：米中間選挙の「キングメーカー」様変わり　ＡＩやオンライン賭博が資金拠出の主役 焦点：米中間選挙巡る賭け急増、予測市場のインサイダー対策は苦戦か 最終更新: 10/24(土) 0:54 ロイター

Data center spending has been a fast-growing source of revenue for industrial firms that make generators, construction equipment, switchgears and chillers. Here are the details

JOHANNESBURG, Oct 23 : South Africa's presidency temporarily took its website offline following a PHP warning, presidential spokesperson Vincent Magwenya told Reuters on Friday, adding there was no indication of a security breach. "While such warnings do not indicate a security breach, they can affect the normal operation of a website," Magwenya said. He added that the website was taken down as a precaution. Governments and businesses worldwide have rushed to secure systems running the PHP programming language after flaws were disclosed, forcing some services offline and triggering millions of hacking attempts in one of the most significant cybersecurity incidents in recent years. PHP underpins a large share of the public web and is widely used by content management systems including WordPress, Drupal and Joomla, giving any critical vulnerability potentially widespread consequences. PHP developers on Wednesday released fixes for the flaws and urged users to update affected systems immediately.

Source: Reuters

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : Six more companies, including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit, will not allow their shares to be tokenized on a joint trading platform backed by crypto exchange OKX and Intercontinental Exchange, according to a regulatory document seen by Reuters.  The new objections, which have not been previously reported, underscore the growing challenges for tokenization, the creation of digital tokens that represent a stock and can be traded on a blockchain similar to cryptocurrencies, despite the US securities regulator recently approving the novel products.  In total, 22 companies have objected, according to the document, which outlines the rules of the OKXICE venture and which companies have objected. It does not say why the companies objected. Sixteen of the companies, including Microsoft and Alphabet, are listed on Nasdaq. The others are listed on the New York Stock Exchange, which ICE owns. Nasdaq has teamed up with Payward, the parent of crypto exchange Kraken, to launch its own tokenized stock platform next year.

A spokesperson for Arm did not immediately provide comment. Spokespeople for Wells Fargo and Intuit declined to comment.  TOKENIZATION ADVOCATES TOUT 24/7 TRADING The cryptocurrency industry has said stock tokenization could revolutionize markets by allowing shares to be traded 24/7 and settled instantly. OKX and ICE had planned to tokenize 63 stocks through their joint venture, but have encountered objections from issuers. OKX and ICE filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission earlier this month to launch tokenized stocks under the agency's new innovation exemption. The exemption allows platforms that facilitate trading of tokenized stocks to operate without complying with many requirements that apply to traditional stock exchanges.  Under the exemption, platforms must notify companies before listing tokenized versions of their stocks, and cannot proceed if the issuer objects.   Speaking to reporters this week, Andrew Cuomo, co-chairman of the OKXICE joint venture, said given how revolutionary tokenization could be, it was natural for companies to take a "wait and see" approach, CoinDesk reported. While Nasdaq says it welcomes tokenization in principle, it has said such products should be subject to the existing set of rules and investor protections. It has warned that if improperly regulated, tokenization could fragment liquidity and undermine price discovery, among other issues.  "Given the risks we believe issuers must be cautious about their participation," the company warned in a September FAQ.  A Nasdaq spokesperson pointed Reuters to its FAQ. Although many overseas tokenized stocks are marketed like stocks, they rarely offer the same rights, disclosures and protections as traditional equities.  Under the SEC's exemption, tokenized stocks must confer the same rights and privileges as traditional securities, including the ability to receive dividends and exercise voting rights.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米総合ＰＭＩ、10月は57.6に小幅低下 販売価格4年超ぶり高水準
item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２３日発表した１０月の米総合購買...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米総合ＰＭＩ、10月は57.6に小幅低下　販売価格4年超ぶり高水準 10/23 23:41 配信

米ペンシルベニア州キャンプヒルにあるＡＭＥＳのシャベル製造工場。2017年6月撮影。REUTERS/Tim Aeppel

Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２３日発表した１０月の米総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は５７．６と、５年ぶり高水準を付けた９月の５８．４から小幅低下した。それでも、堅調な需要を背景に、企業は財（モノ）・サービスの価格を引き上げており、今後数カ月でインフレが一段と加速し、高止まりする可能性があることを示した。

１０月は製造業が底堅く推移したものの、広範なサービス業の小幅な後退によって相殺された。 新規受注指数は５８．２と、前月の５８．１から小幅上昇し、２０２２年３月以来の高水準となった。上昇は主にサービス業によるもので、Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは「予防的な在庫積み増しに一部押し上げられた国内需要の高まり」と輸出の伸びを指摘した。

販売価格指数は５９．８と、９月の５８．４から上昇し、２２年８月以来の高水準となった。製造業・サービス業の双方で企業が価格を引き上げた。

投入価格指数は６４．９と、９月の６５．９から低下したものの、依然として高水準にある。ただ、製造業は今月も価格上昇に直面しており、同指数はなお４年ぶり高水準付近で推移した。

サプライヤー納入指数は３８．１と、９月の４０．９から低下し、４年超ぶりの低水準となった。

９月に急増していた全体の雇用は１０月に低下したものの、製造業では雇用が伸び、製造業の雇用指数は１２年３月以来の高水準となった。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのチーフビジネスエコノミスト、クリス・ウィリアムソン氏は「コスト圧力は引き続き重大な懸念だ」と指摘。「一方で、サプライチェーン（供給網）のボトルネックの問題が深刻化し、受注残が積み上がっている。このため企業はコスト上昇分を顧客に転嫁しやすくなっている」と述べた。

item.title: Explainer-Why AI data centers are powering a boom in fuel-cell demand
item.description: Oct 23 : Fuel cells are gaining traction among US hyperscalers racing to build data centers for the AI boom but struggling with grid constraints to secure quick and reliable power. Energy research firm Rystad Energy projects investments in fuel cells for data centers to rise to about $30 billion by 2030 from

Explainer-Why AI data centers are powering a boom in fuel-cell demand

FAST

Oct 23 : Fuel cells are gaining traction among US hyperscalers racing to build data centers for the AI boom but struggling with grid constraints to secure quick and reliable power. Energy research firm Rystad Energy projects investments in fuel cells for data centers to rise to about $30 billion by 2030 from $2.8 billion in 2025. WHAT ARE FUEL CELLS? A fuel cell generates electricity through a chemical reaction between a fuel, such as natural gas or hydrogen, and oxygen, converting the fuel's energy directly into electricity rather than burning it.

Buzzword

Spot as many words as you can

Show More

Show Less

Bloom Energy operates solid-oxide technology ready for 100 per cent pure hydrogen, while FuelCell Energy uses molten carbonate technology capped at 40 per cent hydrogen blends, even as both systems are fuel-flexible. WHY IS DEMAND GROWING? Data centers require massive amounts of reliable electricity to run computing equipment and cooling systems around the clock. Linking large electricity loads to the US grid can take three to six years, according to Rystad estimates, prodding developers to explore on-site power sources. "We announced our first project with Oracle and delivered power to their Utah site in less than two months," Bloom CEO KR Sridhar said on a post-earnings call on Thursday. "We are achieving the same thing with Nebius in New Jersey. We were able to get planning board approvals for our fuel cells within three months of signing the contract." Rystad predicts that about 40 per cent of projected US data-center capacity in 2030 could pursue dedicated on-site power rather than rely entirely on the grid. Fuel cells also produce lower local emissions than conventional gas-fired generation, as they avoid combustion within the stack. WHICH COMPANIES STAND TO BENEFIT? Bloom's third-quarter revenue surged 138 per cent to $1.24 billion. The company posted net profit of $250.3 million, compared to a year-earlier loss of $23.1 million. It raised its 2026 revenue forecast to $4.4 billion to $4.6 billion. US cloud computing giant Oracle intends to procure up to 2.8 gigawatts (GW) of Bloom fuel-cell systems, of which 1.2 GW has been contracted. FuelCell is also targeting data centers. CEO Jason Few told Reuters that "time to power has really become as important as cost of power." The company expects data centers and related business to account for 75 per cent-85 per cent of its business within two to three years, up from 25 per cent-30 per cent currently. Rystad estimates the industry's order book at roughly 9 GW, including framework agreements involving Oracle, AEP, Equinix and Brookfield. Such agreements do not necessarily represent firm orders for the full stated capacity. CAN THE INDUSTRY SCALE FAST ENOUGH? Rystad expects annual fuel-cell manufacturing capacity to rise to 4 GW by 2030 from about 1.8 GW currently. "For 100 MW-plus projects, the biggest determinants of timeline are typically site readiness, permitting, and supporting infrastructure, not the fuel-cell technology itself," Bloom Chief Commercial Officer Aman Joshi told Reuters. Projects still need gas connections, permits, transformers and switchgear, which can delay deployment. Fuel cells can complement grid power, even as they compete with other on-site generation technologies. Growth depends on whether suppliers can deliver systems at competitive costs and developers can build projects and secure fuel.

Source: Reuters

item.title: India's Scotch probe of Diageo, Pernod undermining India-UK pact benefits, trade group says
item.description: India's move to exclude bulk Scotch imports from a reduced 75% tariff goes against provisions agreed in an India-UK trade deal, a group representing liquor makers Diageo and Pernod Ricard wrote in a letter seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Kalra
item.content:encoded: India's move to exclude bulk Scotch imports from a reduced 75% tariff goes against provisions agreed in an India-UK trade deal, a group representing liquor makers Diageo and Pernod Ricard wrote in a letter seen by Reuters. Whisky tariffs were a sticking point during the years of protracted negotiations leading up to the deal's July 15 implementation, though India ultimately agreed to halve import taxes on certain Scotch imports from 150% to 75% immediately and to 40% over 10 years. The British government said "iconic UK products" like whiskies would benefit from the pact. Indian investigators, however, have privately told companies the reduced rate does not apply to bulk Scotch concentrates, creating the first significant dispute over the free trade agreement since it took effect. India's Directorate of Revenue Intelligence [USN:L4N4650OU TEXT:"searched the offices"] of Pernod (PERP.PA) and Diageo (DGE.L) and questioned executives this month as part of an investigation into whether they misclassified imported products to benefit from the reduced rate. CLASSIFICATION ISSUE RISKS UNDERMINING PACT, GROUP SAYS In a letter to India's commerce minister on Friday, the International Spirits and Wines Association of India wrote that the classification issue "risks undermining, in practice, an important market-access benefit negotiated and agreed between India and the United Kingdom". "The preferential tariff treatment negotiated ... could effectively become unavailable for these imports," continued the letter, a copy of which was seen by Reuters. ISWAI declined to comment on its letter, while India's commerce ministry did not immediately respond. Pernod, which counts India as its biggest market by volume, declined to comment. Diageo did not respond to a request for comment. Both told Reuters earlier this week that they were cooperating with Indian authorities carrying out the investigation. In the British government's first comment on the controversy, a spokesperson said: "We are working with the government of India to resolve this issue to ensure UK businesses can export under the tariffs agreed in the trade deal." Import tariff disputes have long been a [USN:L4N3P10W5 TEXT:"sore point"] for foreign investors in India, who have in the past faced demands for large amounts of back tax. Such disputes have embroiled the likes of Samsung and Volkswagen. Pernod faces antitrust cases in India and a $314 million back-tax demand from Indian authorities, who accuse it of undervaluing some imports. The company denies wrongdoing. BIG IMPLICATIONS FOR INDIA'S DRINKS SECTOR ISWAI's letter underscores the shockwaves the investigation has sent through India's $65 billion alcohol market. Britain accounts for almost 75% of India's imported spirits, primarily driven by Scotch whisky, according to Crisil Ratings. Indian government inspectors have told companies that they do not benefit from the reduced 75% tariff on bulk imports of Scotch concentrates, which must be declared under a customs classification that attracts a 150% duty, three people with direct knowledge of the matter told Reuters. Pernod and Diageo import bulk concentrates, mixing them with other ingredients to produce hugely popular Indian brands like Royal Stag, Blenders Pride and McDowell’s. The three people said companies including Diageo and Pernod believe concentrates imported from Britain should benefit from the new, lower tariff. ISWAI said in its letter that the India-UK agreement expressly provides preferential tariff treatment for whisky under the relevant tariff lines. An urgent clarification could ensure market-access benefits negotiated by India and Britain are realised "while avoiding uncertainty and disruption for legitimate industry participants", the letter said. On Saturday, the UK-based Scotch Whisky Association told Reuters in a statement that the import of bulk Scotch is key to whisky’s overall success in India and that upholding the core principles of the bilateral pact is vital. The association, which counts Diageo and Pernod's Chivas Brothers as members, added the industry was "committed to working in partnership with the UK and Indian governments on the smooth implementation of the deal", so its benefits are unlocked.

item.title: パリ近郊で銃乱射、1人死亡4人負傷 デモ控え厳戒態勢の中
item.description: [パリ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２３日 ロイター] - フランス当局によると、パリ西郊のトラップで２３日、男が車から発砲し、１人が死亡、１２歳の少女を含む４人が負傷した。

マクロン大統領はＸへの投稿で、「既に容疑者を拘束した法執行機関に感謝したい。国家反テロ検察庁が本件を引き継いだ」と表明し、事件に深い悲しみを示した。

トラップのアリ・ラベ町長はＢＦＭＴＶに対し、男が車から発砲し、「無差別に発砲しているように見え、大量殺害を実行しようとしていた様子だった」と述べた。

トラップに隣接するラベリエールのニコラ・ダンビル町長は、容疑者について「近隣市プレジール在住の欧州系の人物」と説明した。ラベ町長は、犠牲者のうち２人がそれぞれアフリカ系と北アフリカ系だったと述べたが、他の犠牲者の背景についての詳細は明らかにしなかった。

今回の銃撃は、２４─２５日の抗議デモを控え、フランス国内の緊張が高まる中で起きた。１７日には全国規模の抗議デモが暴徒化した経緯がある。

当局は、今回の銃撃が人種や宗教を動機とするものだったのかについても捜査の対象に含めるとした。

item.title: 米ＳＥＣ、金融機関検査でＡＩや非公開資産を重点項目に
item.description: [ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - 米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）は２３日、２０２７会計年度（２６年１０月─２７年９月）の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＳＥＣ、金融機関検査でＡＩや非公開資産を重点項目に 10/23 23:05 配信

2025年12月2日、SECのポール・アトキンス委員長　 REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - 米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）は２３日、２０２７会計年度（２６年１０月─２７年９月）の金融機関に対する検査で、人工知能（ＡＩ）の利用や非公開資産、トークン化証券などを重点項目とすると発表した。

トランプ政権は、老後資金を積み立てる人や個人投資家が非公開資産に投資する機会の拡大を進めている。こうした動きは高いリターンをもたらす可能性がある一方で、一般の米国民をより大きなリスクにさらすことにもなる。

ＳＥＣは９月、企業がブロックチェーンを活用したトークン化株式などを提供できるようにするため、５年間の規制適用免除措置を発表した。

ＳＥＣの検査部門は、投資顧問会社や証券会社、証券取引所など、ＳＥＣの監督下にある企業・機関を検査し、不正が見つかった場合は執行部門に付託できる。ＳＥＣは昨年、暗号資産（仮想通貨）分野に対する監視の重点度を引き下げた。

ＳＥＣは声明で、今年度の検査では、プライベートファンドやプライベートクレジットを重点項目に含めるとした。

批判的な立場からは、一般の投資家がこうした資産から期待通りの高いリターンを得られるとは限らず、資産の価格評価が難しいことが多く、すぐには現金化できない点や、手数料について理解していない可能性があるとの指摘が出ている。

声明によると、ＳＥＣは「市場運営や法令順守、不正防止、投資家保護に影響を及ぼし得る」ＡＩなどの技術の利用に加え、証券のトークン化を含む市場構造の変化に伴うリスクにも重点を置く方針だ。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/23(金) 23:05 ロイター

Denmark is among the world's most digitalised countries, and confidence in its digital public ser

COPENHAGEN, Oct 23 : Denmark's heavy reliance on digital systems leaves it vulnerable to cyberattacks that could undermine public trust in authorities, the country's resilience minister told Reuters on Friday. Denmark is among the world's most digitalised countries, and confidence in its digital public services is high. Governments and companies worldwide, including in Denmark, this week took websites offline after critical flaws in a widely used programming language triggered millions of hacking attempts. Danish municipal IT company Kombit, for example, said it had shut down several services, including the national school communication platform. Resilience and Preparedness Minister Lisbeth Bech-Nielsen said Denmark's early embrace of digitalisation had delivered major benefits but also increased its exposure to cyber threats.

Utilities, healthcare and financial services all depend heavily on digital infrastructure. Her main concern is public confidence. Even attacks that cause limited disruption can weaken trust in authorities, she said, while the steady stream of reports about cyber incidents "has a very destructive impact on society". "The new normal is that we're going to be attacked on a daily basis, whether it's Russia, whether it's criminal hackers doing it for economic gain or something else," she said. The high level of trust Danes place in public institutions was evident during the COVID-19 pandemic, when strong vaccine uptake helped the country reopen society relatively quickly. Bech-Nielsen said Denmark needed to invest more in its digital infrastructure and reconsider how much critical equipment should be connected to the internet. She pointed to an incident in France in which freezers were remotely controlled, and questioned whether more local, closed systems would offer greater security. "We need to change some things fundamentally in how we arrange the digital infrastructure in Denmark, but it will affect a lot of people and a lot of ways of living, of doing business," she said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: イスラエル首相 、ヨルダン川西岸地区の住宅破壊表明 兵士2人の殺害受け
item.description: [２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２３日　ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は２３日、占領下のヨルダン川西岸のヘブロンを封鎖し、住宅を軒並み破壊すると表明した。イスラエル軍はこれに先立ち、同市近郊の軍検問所でパレスチナ人の襲撃者らが兵士２人を殺害したと発表していた。

イスラエル軍によると、襲撃者２人を殺害したほか、この襲撃で兵士３人が軽傷を負った。

ネタニヤフ氏は襲撃後の声明で、「われわれはこの場所を破壊し、完全に変えるために行動を起こす」と表明。さらに、イスラエル軍が定期的にパレスチナ人の都市や町を襲撃しているヨルダン川西岸で、大規模な軍事作戦を展開すると述べた。

ロイターの記者は、銃撃現場近くのヘブロンで、イスラエル軍のブルドーザーが住宅の取り壊しを始めたのを確認した。地元住民によると、これらの住宅は襲撃者らとは何の関係もないという。

ネタニヤフ氏は襲撃後の演説で、ヨルダン川西岸地区のイスラエル人入植者を「英雄的」だとし、彼らは「危険な最前線に立っている」と称えた。

今回の襲撃は、来週に控えたイスラエル総選挙を前に発生した。ネタニヤフ氏と同氏が率いる右派連立政権は、イスラエルの入植地の拡大とパレスチナ国家樹立反対を掲げて選挙運動を展開している。

item.title: ロシア・ウクライナ、南部オレシュキで停戦合意 米大統領夫人が仲介
item.description:
Steve Holland Ryan Patrick Jones
[ワシントン／キーウ／モスクワ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Steve Holland　Ryan Patrick Jones

[ワシントン／キーウ／モスクワ　２３日　ロイター] - 米ホワイトハウスは２３日、トランプ米大統領のメラニア夫人が、ロシア占領下にあるウクライナ南部ヘルソン州オレシュキでの停戦合意をロシアとウクライナの間で取り付けたと発表した。停戦は２９日に開始する。ロシアとウクライナもオレシュキでの停戦合意を確認した。

オレシュキは２０２２年２月からロシア占領下にあり、食料支援が滞るなどして住民の人道危機が深刻化。ホワイトハウスの声明によると、ロシアとウクライナは人道支援物資の搬入と、指定された安全な回廊を通した民間人避難の準備を可能にするため、オレシュキでの全ての軍事行動を一時停止することで合意した。

メラニア氏は声明で「オレシュキの状況は極めて深刻だ。オレシュキは最前線の戦闘地域で、壊滅的な事態の瀬戸際にある。現地に残る住民の大半は高齢者で、医療支援や医薬品、食料、清潔な水を緊急に必要としている」とした。メラニア氏によると、停戦期間中はロシアとウクライナ両国の非軍事チームが住民宅を訪問し、ロシアまたはウクライナへの避難を希望する住民の移送を調整する。このプロセスを記録するために米国の報道機関が同行するとしたが、具体的にどの報道機関が同行するかは明らかにしなかった。

＜ロシア、ウクライナ停戦合意確認＞

ウクライナのアラハミヤ首席交渉官は、オレシュキでの停戦が近く実施されると確認。通信アプリ「テレグラム」への投稿で、オレシュキと周辺地域からの避難と食料配送のために恒久的な人道回廊を設置する作戦を近く開始すると表明した。ただ、作戦の詳細は明らかにしなかった。

ロシア大統領府のペスコフ報道官も、米国の仲介でオレシュキを巡る局地的な停戦合意が成立したと確認。オレシュキからの退避を希望する全ての民間人に退避を認めるとし、避難には少なくとも数日かかるとの見通しを示した。オレシュキでの停戦についてはこのほど実施されたプーチン大統領とトランプ米大統領の電話会談でも協議されていたと述べ、停戦実現にメラニア氏が果たした役割を称賛。「人道作戦の調整に多大な貢献を果たしたメラニア夫人の尽力を歓迎する」と語った。

ペスコフ氏の発表を受け、ロシア軍のゲラシモフ参謀総長はオレシュキでの人道作戦を円滑に実施するため、ロシア軍は現地時間２７日午前４時（日本時間同日午前１０時）に攻撃を停止すると発表した。

メラニア氏はこれまでも、戦時中にロシアに連れ去られたウクライナの子どもたちを家族のもとに帰還させる取り組みに積極的に関与。声明によると、メラニア氏は代理人とともに、局地的な停戦条件を取りまとめるためにロシアとウクライナ両国の指導部と直接協議を行った。

オレシュキはドニプロ川を挟んでヘルソン州の州都ヘルソン市の対岸に位置している。ホワイトハウスによると人口は高齢者を中心に約１７００─２０００人と、ロシアによる全面侵攻前の約２万４０００人から減少した。同州のカホフカ水力発電所のダムが攻撃によって破壊された後、 オレシュキの約９０％が浸水したとされている。

FAST

BRUSSELS, Oct 23 : Meta Platforms will delay the implementation of updated commercial terms, so it can address concerns from publishers and digital advertisers, the US tech company said on Friday, in a decision that could stave off potential regulatory action. EU and UK antitrust authorities have received complaints about the new commercial terms, which publishers and digital advertisers said would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services. Meta has rejected the claims. "We are extending the effective date of our updated Commercial Terms and Self-Serve Ad Terms to 20 November to allow more time for us to explain to our partners and stakeholders what's changing and what's not," a Meta spokesperson said in an email. The new commercial terms had previously been set to take effect on October 30.

Meta will explain how it uses web crawlers and make clear that content owners will still be able to use robots.txt — a plain text file that communicates instructions to web crawlers and AI bots — to signal preferences, the spokesperson said. The European Commission, which serves as the EU's antitrust watchdog, said it welcomed the delay, adding that it had sent requests for information to companies that have not yet published summaries about the data used to train their AI models. The European Publishers Council, however, which together with other groups wants regulators to suspend Meta's new commercial terms while they investigate the issue, reiterated its criticism. It pointed to what it said was a lack of clear contractual safeguards against unrelated exploitation of publishers' content. "Maintaining a business page or advertising a subscription should not confer general rights over a publisher’s website and archive," the council's Executive Director Angela Mills Wade said. "Uses beyond those necessary to provide the specific service requested should require separate, express authorisation from the relevant rightsholder," she added. Publishers worldwide are ramping up their fight with AI companies that use their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair-use arguments.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Seven killed as gunmen open fire at church in Jordan in 'terrorist' attack, authorities say
item.description: It is a rare attack on Jordan's Christian minority that authorities described as a terrorist act.
item.dc:creator: Alaa al-Sukhni
item.content:encoded: Seven people were killed on Friday when gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Jordan, said the head of the country's Public Security Directorate, in a rare attack on Jordan's Christian minority that authorities described as a terrorist act by extremists. Speaking at a press conference, Major General Abdallah al-Maaytah said most of those wounded in the shooting at the Hamoud Church in Karak governorate were still receiving treatment, and that the hunt for the attackers was ongoing. Jordan's health minister said 40 people were wounded. Interior Minister Mazin Al Farrayeh said the attack had been carried out by "extremists", but that it was too early to tell whether they had any links to known groups inside or outside Jordan. Such attacks are extremely rare in Jordan, which is relatively stable, though authorities in the US ally say that in recent years they have repeatedly foiled attempted attacks by Islamist militants. There was no immediate claim of responsibility. A video aired on Jordan's state-owned Al-Mamlaka television station that appeared to be from a security camera on the church showed three people firing at it from a sidewalk and hiding behind trees and a low wall. The video showed the attackers then running towards the church's entrance. Reuters was able to verify the video from the entry path and wall surrounding the church, as well as other details. "This is a result of a terrorist ideology and blind extremism and we will not allow society to go down this path," Jordanian Prime Minister Jafar Hassan said in a post on X. Khaled Burqan, who was at the funeral, told Al-Mamlaka that dozens of people were present and the gunmen opened fire on them for several minutes. Ihab Ammareen, another witness, told the station he saw bloodied people collapse on the floor after the attack. "People were crying, wailing, screaming — it's hard to describe," he said. BLOOD SMEARED ON THE GROUND Jordan's King Abdullah, a major US partner in the fight against militant Islamist groups, visited Karak hours after the attack and said the perpetrators would be punished "with an iron fist". "The terrorist attack against Karak will be met with the harshest retaliation. Those who delude themselves into thinking that they can divide Jordanians with their bullets have no chance in the face of our unity," he said in a statement. Reuters footage from the church after the attack showed blood smeared on the floor near its entrance, where security forces were deployed. In a post on X, United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres condemned the violence and said attacks against civilians and places of worship are unacceptable. People who gathered at a Karak government hospital to support the wounded expressed shock. "What happened today has left people unable to speak or raise our voices. But our only reproach to the state is that it must investigate these dark ideas — where they come from and how they enter the minds of our children," said one of them, Hani Al-Mbaydeen. Christians make up a minority of Jordan's population. The country is home to several biblical sites that attract Christian pilgrims from around the world. The US ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz described it on X as a "depraved and brutal attack on a house of worship." Jordan was among the US allies in the region to be hit by Iranian attacks this year after the US and Israel launched strikes against Iran in February.

item.title: British jets join French nuclear exercise for first time, France says
item.description: Britain and France agreed in July 2025 to reinforce cooperation over their nuclear arsenals in response to growing threats to Europe and uncertainty over their US ally.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

British jets join French nuclear exercise for first time, France says

Britain and France agreed in July 2025 to reinforce cooperation over their nuclear arsenals in response to growing threats to Europe and uncertainty over their US ally.

French President Emmanuel Macron and France's Defence Minister Catherine Vautrin arrive for the annual autumn military review in Paris, France, Sep 16, 2026. (Photo: Thomas Padilla/Pool via Reuters)
